First things first: What even ARE meme coins?

Imagine if internet jokes had a baby with Wall Street. That's meme coins. Zero utility, pure vibes, somehow worth billions.

Most famous example? Dogecoin turning a Shiba Inu meme into a $90B asset in 2021. Yes, really. 🐕
